_comment: Single source of truth for emergency keyword detection, used by BOTH the Flutter app and Cloud Functions (tool/sync_shared.sh copies it). Both sides fold the message AND these phrases the same way before matching: lowercase; Azerbaijani letters to ASCII (ə→e, ı/İ→i, ğ→g, ö→o, ü→u, ç→c, ş→s); ё→е; anything that is not a letter or digit becomes a space; spaces collapsed. A phrase matches when it appears at the START of a word in the folded message, so stems work ('угар' matches 'угарный', 'qaz' matches 'qazın') but not mid-word ('pec' does not match 'specialist'). Shared test vectors: emergency_keyword_cases.json. TODO(team): review the word lists with native speakers before launch.

combos._comment: Matches only when at least one phrase from EVERY group appears in the message.
